subject: general
question:
Seven friends, Monika, Janak, Pawan, Lokesh, Rupesh, Sohan and Anand, are sitting in a straight line facing north but not necessarily in the same order. Anand is sitting to the immediate right of Rupesh. Rupesh is sitting fourth to the right of Sohan. Pawan is an immediate neighbour of Janak and Lokesh. Lokesh is third to the right of Sohan, who is sitting at one of ends.

What is the position of Monika with respect to Lokesh?
solution:
According to the given information:

Seven friends, Monika, Janak, Pawan, Lokesh, Rupesh, Sohan and Anand, are sitting in a straight line facing north but not necessarily in the same order.

1) Anand is sitting to the immediate right of Rupesh.

2) Rupesh is sitting fourth to the right of Sohan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/01e282f859808ad27e1bf747f008c9c19f3b014a3bba76796e22e5af462f9a2d.png] 

3) Lokesh is third to the right of Sohan, who is sitting at one of ends.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/961154d3a38a4ab5693afeadcb62689ce605feedfe1a7e83958444312703c391.png] 

4) Pawan is an immediate neighbour of Janak and Lokesh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3ad3eeaceb63f617f352554acad046a55ae5838ff57de10927447bf73a0ac0a5.png] 

So, only Monika is left and one position is vaccant. 

Then final arrangement:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4653d06dade2c3d4a682a53fd847ac8751ca13870e31a54a3510f6214ac2ecc5.png] 

Thus, the position of Monika is third to the right with respect to Lokesh.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Third to the right".**
